item.title: Nagano Apple Picking & Cider Tasting: The Orchard Prefecture — Guide
item.description: Nagano is one of Japan’s leading apple-growing regions, its cool climate, sunny days and well-drained highland soil producing crisp, flavourful apples in varieties from Fuji to Shinano Gold, and each autumn its orchards open to visitors for apple picking. In a picking session, visitors harvest ripe apples straight from the tree, often with all-you-can-eat options, and many orchards and nearby producers also offer fresh apple juice and cider tasting, turning a simple harvest activity into a fuller taste of the region’s orchard culture.
